name: fleet-box-helper
description: fleet-box's helper, which serves a session container's files and processes to the host from inside it, and where it sits in the session image, which `fleet-setup image` installs it in

scripts.test: node -e "for (const path of ['lib', 'tsconfig.tsbuildinfo']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b && node --test "lib/**/*.test.js"
